title: Case: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight
context: Freight allocation is paused because pallet dimensions and weight are missing. The shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
initial_request: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

events.from: Freight booking desk, Umberlea Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-8487 has one pallet at Fallowmere Span Fabrication, but its dimensions and weight fields are blank. We cannot allocate a collection vehicle from an unspecified pallet size.

events.from: Nerys Jessop, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-8487 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

events.from: Lorcan Gallimore, Fallowmere Span shipping coordinator
events.body: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Lorcan Gallimore, Fallowmere Span shipping coordinator
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for measured dimensions and weight before carrier allocation.

must_not: Customer measurements are not an independent carrier weighing; allocation is not collection.
Treats the claim from Nerys Jessop (who has no recorded link to DL-8487) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Nerys Jessop's message
expected.reference_message: Please provide measured length, width and total height including pallet, plus gross weight including packaging, for DL-8487. We will pass those actual measurements to the carrier.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-043: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. An unverified bystander, Nerys Jessop, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
